---
title: Statistical Intuition and Applications (UL)
subtitle: Course Redesign (Summer 2025)
---

## Context
This redesign targets first-year Entrepreneurship & Innovation students with mixed math confidence. The goal was to make statistics feel actionable by grounding lessons in business scenarios and decision-making.

## Learning goals (examples)
- Interpret data summaries in plain language and connect them to business choices.
- Use frequentist probability as a model of uncertainty from observed data.
- Run guided notebook workflows and explain results to a non-technical audience.

## Design decisions
- **Consistent lesson rhythm:** PCW → Polls → Breakout → Closure to reduce cognitive load.
- **Business-first framing:** every concept introduced through a realistic scenario.
- **Scaffolded computation:** notebooks emphasize parameter changes + interpretation rather than blank-page coding.
